messages:
sara_sales: Hey team — AtlasCare POC kickoff today. They want to run a custom med-qa model (med-qa-7b-v2) with our private deployment. Can someone confirm variant compatibility and whether we support int4 quant + KMS key rotation for this?
devon_se: @sara_sales we can serve med-qa-7b-v2 but need to validate tokenizer parity. Do they use SentencePiece or GPT2-style?
sara_sales: They said SentencePiece, trained with 32k vocab. Also asked about latency SLOs: target 150ms p50 for 1-2 concurrent requests (interactive UI).
mike_infra: SentencePiece is fine. Biggest risk is int4 quantized KV-cache behavior — need to run a compatibility sweep to ensure no generation degeneration. I can spin a small dedicated pool for validation.
sara_sales: Perfect. Any cost delta for int4 vs fp16 on Dedicated? Ops asked about pricing for the POC (1 month).
mike_infra: int4 typically ~1.8x throughput vs fp16 on same GPU -> lower cost per token. For Dedicated pricing we should use our quantized profile tier (see docs) — estimate I'll post after the sweep.
natalie_sec: Security note: AtlasCare requires HSM-backed KMS and SOC2 controls on logs. We support CMEK via customer KMS in Private. Need to confirm audit-log retention and key rotation policy.
sara_sales: Can you confirm rotation policy and a short blurb I can send them for the SOC questionnaire?
natalie_sec: Short blurb: "Redwood Private supports customer-managed keys (CMEK) integrated with common KMS providers. Keys can be rotated on customer schedule; Redwood never persists plaintext model keys. Audit logs for inference requests and admin actions can be configured to meet retention requirements; we can share SOC2 artifacts under NDA."
sara_sales: Awesome. @ops_bot please create a ticket and run an onboarding compatibility sweep for med-qa-7b-v2 (tokenizer/kv/quant). Include perf harness for 128-token seq and 512-token seq.
ops_bot: Ticket created: RINF-8421 — "AtlasCare / med-qa-7b-v2 onboarding sweep". Assignee: mike_infra. ETA: 48h.
mike_infra: Starting sweep now. Quick config I'm testing: ```model: med-qa-7b-v2
quant: int4
cache: kv
seqs: [128,512]
batching: continuous
``` I will post results in this thread.
devon_se: Also flagging tokenizer mismatch tests + fuzz inputs from their dataset. If anything degrades we can suggest a small FP16 canary variant.
sara_sales: Thanks. I'll prep the SOC questionnaire answers and draft a POC pricing email. Will ping when you have numbers. :thumbsup:
